name: maybe_Snd_IpcCmd20
signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_IpcCmd20(unsigned int* session, unsigned char value)
summary: IPC stub sending command 0x20 (header 0x00200040) with one translated word on the given session handle and returning the reply; used by the channel-flush pair.
evidence: Header constant 0x00200040, svc 0x32 SendSyncRequest, callers are the two Snd flush routines passing the handle at 0x007AEA00+8; session owner still unidentified.

name: maybe_Gfx_InitE8Record
summary: Zeroes the ten leading words of a 0xE8-byte record and memsets the two 0x60-byte buffers at +0x28 and +0x88; called twice by the engine-startup record-pair constructor.
evidence: Layout provable from body (0x88+0x60=0xE8) and sole caller is maybe_Engine_InitRecordPair; purpose of the record itself unproven.

name: maybe_Snd_SetupChannelBuffers
summary: One-time layout of stream buffers: optionally uploads the 0x1080-byte wave buffer, queries driver buffer count/size, splits the region into 24 blocks each of 0xC0/0xC/0x20 bytes, stores pointer arrays and latches the double-buffer index at +0x1322.
evidence: Only caller is maybe_Snd_InitStreamContext; writes selector at +0x1322 used by Snd_SetChannel* setters; exact buffer semantics not fully proven.

name: maybe_Svc_IpcStubFragment
summary: Not a real function start: continuation of the preceding IPC stub (store word at (b>>1)+0x10, svc 0x32, read reply at (b>>1)+4).
evidence: No branch target reaches this address; body is a textbook SendSyncRequest stub tail inside the previous routine.

name: maybe_Snd_IpcCmd15
signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_IpcCmd15(unsigned int* session, unsigned int unitFlag, unsigned int unitIndex, unsigned int c)
summary: IPC stub for command 0x15 (header 0x00150082) forwarding three words and returning the reply; used as the write half of a read-modify-write over a per-unit flag mask.
evidence: Header 0x00150082, svc 0x32; sole caller is the unit-flag setter 0x001123B0 using the 0x007AEA00+8 handle.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelField1A
summary: Writes the 16-bit field at +0x1a of the current channel block and marks it dirty (bit 0x10000000), returning 1 on success and 0 when the driver is not ready.
evidence: Sole caller is Snd_SetOutputMode; block selection via ctx+0x1322 into the 24-entry pointer table at ctx+0x10a4 matches the named Snd_SetChannel* setters, but the logical meaning of +0x1a is unproven.

name: maybe_Svc_IpcCmd19
summary: Parameterless IPC request with header 0x190000 (command 0x19) on the session word passed in, returning the reply; used as the final notification before closing the session.
evidence: Header 0x190000, svc 0x32; sole caller is maybe_Os_SignalAndClose which signals then closes the session; session owner unidentified.

name: maybe_Os_IpcCmd08
signature: uint32_t maybe_Os_IpcCmd08(uint32_t* session, uint32_t word1, uint32_t word2, uint32_t word3)
summary: Fills the thread-local IPC request block (header 0x00080082, three payload words), issues svc 0x32 and returns the reply word; the meaning of the payload words is not visible.
evidence: Only caller is maybe_Os_StoreThreadLocalValue; body writes TLS+0x80 header and svc 0x32, but no named caller or constant identifies the command semantics.

name: maybe_std_ScalbnRoundTail
signature: double maybe_std_ScalbnRoundTail(u32 sign, u32 mantissaHigh, u32 mantissaLow, int exponent)
summary: Rounding/overflow tail of the double scalbn helper: increments the mantissa, propagates carry into the exponent and saturates to infinity.
evidence: No external callers; only branch target is inside its own range; body uses unaff_r11/in_CY (damaged decompilation).

name: maybe_Video_ConvertBlocks32_SamePlane
summary: In-place saturating colour/format conversion over four lanes 0x400 bytes apart, selected by dispatcher 0x0012A84C when the context's two pointers are equal.
evidence: Dispatcher 0x0012A84C selects this when *context == context[1]; body reads lanes at -0x200/-0x100/0/+0x100 and writes back in place.

name: maybe_Video_ConvertBlocks16_A
summary: In-place 16-byte-block conversion averaging neighbouring bytes and saturating differences, selected by dispatcher 0x0012A81C when the context's two pointers are equal.
evidence: Dispatcher 0x0012A81C picks this when *context == context[1]; body reads six lanes 0x400 apart and averages/saturates.

name: maybe_Video_ConvertPlanes4_A
summary: Plane-oriented conversion with a four-field descriptor, 0x400-byte plane stride and 0x3e0 row offset, selected by 0x0012A81C when the two pointers differ.
evidence: Dispatcher 0x0012A81C selects this when pointers differ; body loops four planes with 0x400/0x3e0 constants.

name: maybe_Video_ConvertPlanes3_A
summary: Sibling plane conversion with the same four-field descriptor and 4x-unrolled plane loop, selected by dispatcher 0x0012A84C.
evidence: Dispatcher 0x0012A84C pairs it with 0x00126B0C; body matches 0x001290A0 with 0x400/0x3e0 constants; the 3-vs-4 plane numbering is unproven.

name: maybe_Video_ConvertBlocks8_B
summary: Smallest family member: 8-byte-block conversion reading four lanes 0x100 bytes apart (src+0x800) with saturating arithmetic.
evidence: No direct branch target; lane offsets -0x80/-0x40/0/+0x40 come from the body; no named caller confirms the role.

name: maybe_Video_ConvertPlanes4_B
summary: Same plane-descriptor conversion as 0x001290A0 but with a 0x100-byte plane stride and 0xe0 row offset (different plane pitch).
evidence: Byte-compared with 0x001290A0: only stride constants differ (0x100/0xe0 vs 0x400/0x3e0); four-field descriptor loop identical.

name: maybe_Video_ConvertPlanes3_B
summary: Plane-descriptor copy routine with 0x100-byte plane stride and 0xe0 row offset; same body as 0x00129EF4 with different pitch constants. No callers or named callees, so the exact video role stays unknown.
evidence: Doc: byte-compared with twin 0x00129EF4, only stride constants differ (0x100/0xe0 vs 0x400/0x3e0); body is a 4x-unrolled u32 copy loop over descriptor fields.

name: maybe_Video_ConvertPlanes4_C
summary: Plane-descriptor copy routine with 0x200-byte plane stride and 0x1e0 row offset; same body as 0x0012CE18 with different pitch constants. No callers or named callees.
evidence: Doc: byte-compared with twin 0x0012CE18, only stride constants differ (0x200/0x1e0 vs 0x100/0xe0); body is the same 4x-unrolled u32 copy loop.

name: maybe_Video_ConvertPlanes3_C
summary: Plane-descriptor copy routine with 0x200-byte plane stride and 0x1e0 row offset; same body as 0x0012DC6C with different pitch constants. No callers or named callees.
evidence: Doc: byte-compared with twin 0x0012DC6C, only stride constants differ (0x200/0x1e0 vs 0x100/0xe0); body is the same 4x-unrolled u32 copy loop.

name: maybe_Video_DecodeCoefficientGroupEven
signature: void maybe_Video_DecodeCoefficientGroupEven(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, int bitCount, u32 bitReservoir)
summary: VLC case body of an MPEG-style block decoder: consumes bits from the reservoir, remaps the escape code, and jumps through the 16-entry table at 0x135418 to decode up to four coefficients. Body is damaged (unaff_r6/unaff_r11) and reached only via computed jump.
evidence: Doc: no direct branch target reaches 0x00135104; body uses unaff_r6/unaff_r11 and a computed jump table at 0x135418; only named callee is unrelated Ui_LayoutText_SetupTextureCombiners (likely a mis-listed tail).

name: maybe_Video_DecodeCoefficientGroupOdd
signature: void maybe_Video_DecodeCoefficientGroupOdd(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, int bitCount, u32 bitReservoir)
summary: Other case body of the same block decoder: takes a 4-bit prefix, clamps the code index against subblock counts f_51/f_58, rewrites the four current-code bytes and jumps through the shared 0x135418 table. Heavily damaged decompilation.
evidence: Doc: no direct branch target reaches 0x001351C8; 17 unreachable blocks removed; body reads iVar2->f_51/f_58 and uses unaff_r6; no named callers or callees.

name: maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesWord4
signature: void maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesWord4(const u32* src, u32* dst, int count)
summary: SIMD horizontal sample filter over four packed 32-bit words using 0x7F7F7F7F mask to compute 1:2:1 averages across 16 byte samples, with 0x400-stride loop over count/2 scanline pairs. Internal uncalled filter kernel.
evidence: Body: 0x7F7F7F7F masked shifts/adds implementing 1:2:1 byte averages; src[0x100]/dst[0x100] stride 0x400; count decremented by 2; no callers or callees.

name: maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesWord4b
signature: void maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesWord4b(const u32* src, u32* dst, int count)
summary: SIMD horizontal sample filter variant applying 0x7F7F7F7F masked 1:2:1 filtering over four words with inverted sample ordering across byte boundaries; 0x400-stride loop. Internal uncalled filter kernel.
evidence: Body: same 0x7F7F7F7F mask and 0x400-stride loop as Word4 but with >>8 / <<24 byte-boundary ordering; no callers or callees.

name: maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesWord4c
signature: void maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesWord4c(const u32* src, u32* dst, int count)
summary: SIMD horizontal sample filter variant applying 0x7F7F7F7F masked 1:2:1 filtering over four words shifted by unaligned byte offsets (-1, +3, +7, +0xB). Internal uncalled filter kernel.
evidence: Body: 0x7F7F7F7F mask with 0x1010000 multipliers and >>0x10/>>8 shifts over src-1, src+3, src+7, src+0xB; 0x400-stride loop; no callers or callees.

name: maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesWord4d
signature: void maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesWord4d(const u32* src, u32* dst, int count)
summary: Packed-byte 1:2:1 averaging filter over 0x400-stride lanes using 0x7F7F7F7F masks; no callers or named callees to pin the subsystem.
evidence: 0x7F7F7F7F mask and shift/add averaging; no callers, no named callees, no strings.

name: maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesBlock
signature: void maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesBlock(const u32* src, u32* dst, int count)
summary: Same 0x7F7F7F7F masked averaging filter with more live accumulators; still unlinked to any named caller.

name: maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesBlock2
signature: void maybe_Video_FilterPackedBytesBlock2(const u32* src, u32* dst, int count)

name: maybe_Thunk_Call00100F04
summary: Eight-byte thunk into 0x100F04, which wraps CRT helper 0x3007B8 with leading argument 0xC; target unidentified.

name: maybe_Os_InitStringRecord
summary: Allocates record 0x04000027 and stores locale/region string pointers into +4 and +0xC; the getters are still only maybe_ named.

name: maybe_Gfx_SetFramePeriod
summary: Stores a value into two context fields then resets two unreadable counters; the 'frame period' reading is unverified.
evidence: Two stores plus calls to 0x107894/0x107880 with no readable bodies; no callers.

name: Engine_InitRecordPair
summary: Stores the id in the header word and initialises the two 0xE8-byte records at +4 and +0xEC, returning the object base; called only from Engine_Initialize.
evidence: Only caller is Engine_Initialize (0x101B74); body stores id then calls 0x108C00 twice on the two sub-records; the +0xE8/-0xEC arithmetic cancels.

name: maybe_Os_GetDefaultLocaleString
summary: Returns a pointer into the built-in string area, or 0 when an override name resolves through 0x10540C; the meaning of the string is unproven.
evidence: Only caller is 0x102828 which stores this and the sibling getter into one record; return arithmetic damaged, no string identity evidence.

name: maybe_Os_GetRegionString
summary: Second built-in string getter structurally identical to 0x105238, called immediately after it by 0x102828 to fill the second field of the same record.
evidence: Same shape as 0x105238, same sole caller 0x102828 storing both results; string identity still unproven.

name: Os_ClearThreeWords
summary: Zeroes the three words at the given pointer and returns that pointer unchanged; the callee is a verified three-word zero store.
evidence: Callee 0x10B258 is `mov r1,#0; mov r2,r1; mov r3,r1; stm r0,{r1,r2,r3}`; wrapper saves r0, calls it, returns r0.

name: maybe_Os_GetInitPhase
summary: Returns 1 when the global byte at 0x7AE939 is zero and 2 otherwise; a phase/init flag read by many subsystems.
evidence: Disassembly is push/bl 0x1146F0/cmp/moveq 1/movne 2; 0x1146F0 loads signed byte at 0x7AE939 and 0x114700 stores 1 there; 35 callers across engine/UI/field.

name: maybe_Gfx_InitChannelQueue
summary: Initialises a channel record: stores the handle, initialises two sub-objects, sets sentinel -1 in the queue slot, links the global object from 0x7E7DE0 and sets state words.
evidence: Only caller Os_ListAppendNode; 0x1125BC is a getter for 0x7E7DE0; helpers 0x10C4B8/0x10C660 still unreadable so record type unproven.

name: maybe_Gfx_DispatchVramRegionRequest
summary: Picks the VRAM region containing the requested address (0x20000 or 0x30000) and forwards the request to that region's allocator.
evidence: Bounds helpers 0x1109DC/0x1109A0 are the VRAM region base/end getters; forwards to 0x10E66C or virtual slot +4 of 0x7AE61C+0x14; returns nothing.

name: maybe_Gfx_GetVramRegionSize
summary: Returns the size of a VRAM region: 0x180000/0x280000 when the extended-memory query succeeds, otherwise 0x300000; 0 for other regions.
evidence: Constants match the region base/end getters (0x1F000000+0x180000, 0x1F000000+0x300000-1); region arrives in a flag register so signature is damaged.

name: maybe_Snd_WriteChannelEntry
signature: void maybe_Snd_WriteChannelEntry(char* obj, unsigned int value, unsigned int extra)
summary: Damaged stub that writes a halfword at +2 and a word at +4 of an object and mirrors it into the CSND hardware state; no branch reaches it and the body uses unaff_r6/in_s0, so the name stays a guess.
evidence: No caller reaches 0x0010C642; body uses unaff_r6 and in_s0 (damaged decompilation); only the g_csndHardwareState mirror and 0x118D00 call hint at sound.

name: maybe_Gfx_InvokeCallbacks
summary: Invokes the two registered callback slots (+0x40/+0x44 with contexts +0x80/+0x84) of the global block at 0x7AE954 after a conditional call to 0x1139A0; owner of the block is unknown.
evidence: Body depends on in_ZR and an unrecovered jump table; only caller is Mem_MapSharedBlock; callback slots are the only verified content.

name: maybe_Gfx_ResetStateBlock
summary: Re-initialises the 0x7AE954 object via 0x114398 and clears its 28 state/counter words; reset half of the same object whose callbacks 0x10CB30 invokes.
evidence: Clears fields +0xC..+0x3C and +0x4C..+0x88 of g_gpuCallbackListHead after calling 0x114398; callers include Gfx_UpdateDisplayState and Fs_* request builders, so the owner is still unnamed.

name: maybe_Container_ResetObject
summary: No dossier or readable body available, so the existing container-reset guess cannot be verified.
evidence: No dossier (no readable file); name kept as-is.

name: maybe_Gfx_GetVramRegionEnd
summary: Returns the inclusive end address of a 3DS VRAM bank (0x1F2FFFFF for 0x20000, 0x1F5FFFFF for 0x30000, 0 otherwise); the real entry is 0x11099C and the seed starts mid-function.
evidence: Literals match 3DS VRAM bank ends; body takes region in a flag register (in_ZR) because the seed is mid-function; callers include InitHeaps and Gfx_ModelResource_Parse.

name: maybe_Gfx_GetVramRegionBase
summary: Returns the base address of a 3DS VRAM bank (0x1F000000/0x1F180000 for 0x20000, 0x1F300000/0x1F380000 for 0x30000, 0 otherwise) with the 0x180000 extended-memory delta; real entry is 0x1109D8.
evidence: Returned literals are the two 3DS VRAM bank bases; 0x180000 delta matches the region-size getter; region arrives in a flag register (mid-seed).

name: maybe_Os_CallFinalizers
summary: Runs the eight registered shutdown hooks of the table at 0x7E79B8 once and clears the initialised byte at 0x7AEA02; the owning driver is unnamed.
evidence: Walks 8-slot hook table g_dspShutdownCallbacks and clears g_dspServiceState+2; callers are Gfx_ServiceDisplayTransfer and Snd_InitStreamContext, so the driver is still unknown.

name: maybe_Snd_SetUnitFlagBit
signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_SetUnitFlagBit(unsigned int handle, unsigned int enable, unsigned int unitIndex)
summary: Read-modify-write of a per-unit flag bit: builds 1<<(enable+unitIndex), compares with the cached mask at 0x7AEA0C, sends the change through the command-0x15 stub 0x11874C and updates the cache, returning 0xC8A0A7F8 when already in that state.
evidence: Cached mask at 0x7AEA0C and command-0x15 stub 0x11874C; callers include Snd_InitStreamContext/TeardownStreamContext but also Input/Hid pad readers, so the Snd prefix is not fully proven.

name: Snd_InvalidateChannelObjects
summary: Walks the 24 channel-slot pointers in the sound context table at +0x18DC and stores 0xFFFF into each channel object's halfword at +0x6C, marking every channel slot invalid/unused.
evidence: Callee 0x0011EE6C is exactly `mvn r1,#0; strh r1,[r0,#0x6c]; bx lr`, so it only invalidates; 24-entry loop over +0x18DC table; called from Sound_Frame_BeginUpdate and Snd_InitStreamContext.

name: maybe_Gfx_CommandListWorker_Interior
signature: void maybe_Gfx_CommandListWorker_Interior(u32 arg1, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d)
summary: Not a real function start: interior code of the preceding routine (0x00114AB4 maybe_Gfx_CommandListWorker) that byte-swaps a pointer and stores values into it; kept only for coverage.
evidence: No caller and no data pointer to this address; body is a byte-swap idiom storing into the swapped pointer; only 'caller' is the enclosing routine 0x00114AB4.
